noah: quick flag from newmodel-bench (qcode-6b-int4) 111: long-code prompts in the promptbank are getting truncated differently post-quant, causing dedupe mismatches for code anchors. tagging @labeling-team
isabel: example? collapse or split?
noah: example pair: original prompt (long) includes full code block with function signature; variant is minor whitespace/paren reorder. under int4 runtime the trailing tokens are truncated earlier so the rolling fingerprint hashes differ -> same logical anchor split into two.
kevin: that explains a few odd eval deltas we saw on code-completion benchmarks. how many anchors impacted?
noah: qbench reports ~5.1k anchor deltas across code_promptset (~120k total). ~410 anchors touching golden labels.
felix: truncation length changed by runtime kernel update (v1.3.7) when using chunked attention + shorter kv cache alignment. runtime trimmed final tokens during batching.
labeling-ops: export queued: `export_prompts --set code_promptset --filter "anchor_truncation=true" --out s3://redwood/tmp/code_trunc_1820.json` (job id: 9932)
isabel: plan: (1) add minimal repro to infra repo showing trimmed token ids, (2) run targeted re-fingerprint for affected anchors with dry-run, (3) A/B test fallback fingerprint that includes last-20-char suffix as part of hash for code prompts.
kevin: agree. for code prompts we should prefer char-suffix-aware fingerprint to avoid losing semantics from trailing tokens. set A/B slice to 8k, include ~1k flagged anchors.
noah: i'll open PR with repro + `tools/recompute_fp.py --dry-run --set code_promptset --slice s3://...` by EOD.
felix: labelers: heads-up contractor queues may see ~400 requeues during rescue. labeling-ops can you confirm capacity?
labeling-ops: contractor lead notified, will add +3 reviewers for 3 hours tomorrow 10:00-13:00 PT. golden edits require 2 approvers per policy; will enforce via web UI.
isabel: also run quick sweep on int8 and fp16 to confirm truncation only on int4 runtime.
kevin: experiment metrics: anchor delta, golden-anchor churn, code-completion eval delta (pass@1/5), and duplicate rate. target eval delta <0.4% absolute.
noah: fine. deploy-bot can you schedule export completion notification and calendar invite?
deploy-bot: export job 9932 started; notify on completion. Calendar event created: "qcode-6b-int4 code prompt rescue" tomorrow 10:00-13:00 PT.
felix: governance: any golden label changes must include a git diff, provenance tag (fp_migration=v1), and two approvers. no direct DB edits.
isabel: good. kevin 1 can you prototype the suffix-aware fallback quickly so we can A/B tomorrow?
kevin: on it. will post a PR link here when ready.
noah: recap: noah PR + dry-run re-fp, kevin suffix-fallback A/B (8k), labeling-ops capacity, deploy-bot export & invite. triage by EOD tomorrow. I'll update this thread with PR and A/B outputs.
isabel: thanks all. :thumbsup:
